 UFC Vegas 124 live blog: Waldo Cortes-Acosta vs. Johnny Walker
 Waldo Cortes Acosta and Johnny Walker face off in the main event of UFC Vegas 124
 by Jed Meshew Nov 8, 2026, 3:34 AM UTC Facebook 
 Link 
 Waldo Cortes Acosta and Johnny Walker face off ﻿Photo by Chris Unger/Zuffa LLC) This is the live blog for Waldo Cortes-Acosta vs. Johnny Walker, the heavyweight main event for Saturday’s UFC Vegas 124 card at the UFC Meta APEX.
 Originally, this main event was supposed to be a welterweight showcase fight between top contenders Gabriel Bonfim and Sean Brady, but after Brady was forced out with a serious staph infection, that bout was scrapped, and the UFC scrambled to put together a short-notice heavyweight headliner.
 Cortes-Acosta enters the bout on a two-fight losing streak, dropping a disappointing decision to Curtis Blaydes in September, while Walker made his heavyweight debut just last month, picking up a quick knockout win over Mick Parkin at UFC 332. Now these two heavy hitters face off to get in the mix at the top of the division.
 Check out the live blog for Cortes-Acosta vs. Walker below.
 Preamble
 We’ve had an commentator change! Fitzgerald was too sick to continue, so the UFC had to go to the emergency goalie like in hockey. Never seen that before.
 Pre Fight
 Walker does look like a real heavyweight. He’s always been a huge light heavyweight, and while it doesn’t seem like he’s added muscle, the weight class just doesn’t seem too big for him.
 WCA out and he is brimming with confidence.
 Walker is 2 inches taller and has a 4-inch reach advantage, but he’s a +185 underdog to WCA, who is -225.
 Buffer gets things going and the APEX crowd tries its best.
 The two men meet in the middle for final instructions and touch gloves. Go time!
 Round 1
 Both men out in orthodox and we’re straight to the action with Walker throwing hard leg kicks. WCA putting heavy pressure on immediately and Walker is moving around the cage. But he’s also drilling some hard leg kicks early. WCA swinging big punches and coming up with air as Walker keeps moving. I suspect this will slow down soon.
 Or not! WCA keeps walking him down and he gets Walker to the fence! Walker lands another hard kick, but WCA unloads a combination and a right hand gets through! Walker sits down but he’s right back up. Eyes seem clear but WCA cracked him and now we’re in a clinch along the fence.
 Walker spins him and WCA lands a good knee and elbow before Walker breaks. Big leg kicks from Walker though and those are gonna add up. But WCA throws that FASTBALL right hand and lands. Walker circles away and keeps chopping away with the legs. WCA’s legs are looking a little worn, his footwork a bit wonky.
 And Walker keeps going. WCA charges in with another combo and just barely misses. Walker is not defending well, and he’s in real danger if one lands. Walker in constant motion, WCA walking him down. But Walker keeps kicking, and WCA keeps jumping into punches, landing another right hand along the fence. That leads to another clinch and then some hockey fighting from WCA! With short time, Walker decides to stand and bang and they’re heaving leather! Walker on the march and WCA fires back! The horn sounds and they keep swinging for a few more seconds! Strong end to the round.
 MMA Fighting scores the round 10-9 Walker. 
 Round 2
 Both men look a wee bit tired, and it makes sense. WCA’s legs have to be cooked, and Walker can’t possibly keep this movement up.
 Walker back to the leg kicks. But WCA lands a big right hand that backs him up. Walker keeps chopping though, and it’s working. WCA won’t stop bullrushing him. This is kind of ugly but pretty fun.
 Another big right from WCA as Walker’s movement is slowing down. But he keeps kicking. At some point WCA’s legs have to give out. But not yet and WCA has him against the fence and he unloads! But Walker throws a spinning elbow that catches the arms and backs him up! We’re having fun in there.
 Oh wow, WCA checked a kick. That’s new. Both men slowing down noticeable. Walker’s mouth is wide open and he keeps backing up. This is not good for him, big picture. And WCA lands a right hand.
 Walker tries to spin again but he sort of falls down and WCA obliges him, taking top position, half guard. Elbows and punches from WCA here as Walker accepts the position and just plays defense. WCA with elbows to the body, hammer fists up top. WCA is not doing a huge amount here, but Walker is tired and this is scoring.
 MMA Fighting scores the round 10-9 Cortes-Acosta, 19-19 overall. 
 Round 3
 WCA smells blood, coming right and and landing a big right hand. He is throwing heat early and Walker is trying to back away and stick a jab. He has no defense though and we get into a clinch. Walker turns him and goes for a jumping knee in the clinch. They get to space and Walker lands a 1-2 that was nice. Probably his best punches of the fight.
 WCA keeps walking him down, though. And the big right hand lands again. Walker might be breaking under the pressure. Another clinch and both men breathing deeply. WCA tries to spin but misses. They stay clinched. Not a ton of action and Jason Herzog breaks them up.
 WCA slowing hard. That right hand was way off. Looked impossibly slow. OHHHH! As WCA was too slow, Walker cracks him with a head kick! WCA was out of position and ate that clean, and he’s on stilts! Funny step from WCA and Walker senses the moment! A charge of offense from Walker! Huge right hand drops WCA! And a MONSTER follow up shot ends the fight!!!! What a turn of events!!!!
 Official Decision
 Johnny Walker def. Waldo Cortes-Acosta via KO (head kick and punches) — 2:27, Round 4
 Post Fight
 Walker did his classic post-fight worm. Crazy times we live in, he’s a top-10 heavyweight now.
 Walker talks to Bisping and starts by thanking WCA, saying without someone like him, you can’t make a great fight. Then he thanks Jesus. Then he goes elsewhere.
 “F*ck everyone who says I have no chin!”
 Walker then shouts out the fans, before saying he’s going to New York with Alexander Volkov next week (Volkov is in his corner) saying they’re at the top of the division and want to watch the title fight.
